newsitem.title: SPAIN: Car bomb kills one, injures seven in south Spain.
newsitem.headline: Car bomb kills one, injures seven in south Spain.

text.p: One person was killed and seven were injured in a car bomb explosion in the southern Spanish city of Granada on Monday, police said.
Police said the blast occurred on a road leading to a military base, about two kilometres from the city centre. The likely target was a military van passing through the area, the added.
The Interior Ministry said the explosion was likely to have been a guerrilla attack.
"Everthing is very confused at the moment as it usually is after a terrorist attack but sadly we can confirm there is one person dead," State Secretary for the Interior Ricardo Marti said on radio.
Marti said the victim was a hairdresser at the Armilla military airbase.
